why this belongs to Track 04

Abstract

Designer Hub turns an exported interior-design scheme (as produced by the VirtuHome app) into an on-chain creative asset: every scheme is an ERC-721 with on-chain lineage that can be remixed, attributed, and paid for automatically. Creators set their own price, and every use pays out instantly — 90/10 for an original, 85/10/5 for a remix, with no platform vault. The primary flow is a Passkey (WebAuthn / P-256) smart account: the key never leaves the device’s secure element, and a relayer can sponsor gas without ever being able to alter a call. The content itself never goes on-chain — only a commitment hash does. It ships as a primitive set that any third party can integrate.

What it is

Four composable primitives

Deliberately not specific to interior design: “a tamper-proof way to sign, attribute, and pay for content that is generated and remixed over time” applies to any generative content.

Identity

Passkey smart account

P256PasskeyAccount + PasskeyAccountFactory. Mnemonic-free; address = CREATE2(x, y, rpIdHash, originHash). The private key never leaves the device’s secure element. A real WebAuthn assertion is verified on-chain, binding the exact calldata and nonce, so any relayer can pay gas without being able to alter the call.

Provenance / data ownership

Content attestation

ProvenanceRegistry stores only a commitment keccak256(contentHash ‖ salt) — the content itself never goes on-chain, yet provenance and a timestamp are provable. Privacy-preserving attribution.

Remixable assets with lineage

Scheme NFT + market

DreamScheme (ERC-721 + ERC-2981) records on-chain lineage (parentId, v1→v2→v3). SchemeMarket: creator sets the price; applying a scheme pays out instantly and directly — 90/10 original, 85/10/5 remixed. No vault, no withdraw().

Two distinct fees, kept explicit:
• Platform / lineage fee (charged per apply) — the platform’s cut: 10% of the apply price for an original (the 90/10 split), or 10% platform plus 5% to the ancestor pool for a remix (the 85/10/5 split). Paid in the same transaction; there is no separate standing platform fee or subscription.
• Resale royalty (ERC-2981) — 5% by default, configurable by the creator between 5% and 10%; paid automatically on any secondary sale, on top of the apply split.

Agent trust

AI agent registry

AgentRegistry registers AI generators and reputation; mint / remix carry the generating agentId on-chain, so a scheme and the model that generated it are publicly attributable. Kimi is pre-registered as agentId = 1.

AI model integration

Plans generated with Kimi and other AI models — attributable on-chain

Interior-design schemes are generated with Kimi and other AI models. On-chain, the AI generator is registered through AgentRegistry (Kimi pre-registered as agentId = 1) with its reputation recorded — so both the scheme and the model that generated it are publicly attributable.

How it works

One scheme JSON (or a base64url scheme code) in, one on-chain asset out

The VirtuHome app hands off a scheme — as raw scheme JSON or as a compact, compressed base64url scheme code (deflate-raw + base64url) that can be pasted straight in.

01Home & gallery — browse on-chain schemes
02Passkey login → CREATE2 account (gas sponsored)
03Pin metadata to IPFS → mint ERC-721
04Remix (parentId on-chain)
05Apply → instant split (90/10, 85/10/5)
06Leaderboard & split ledger

For developers · Design & Craft (20%)

Build on it without our UI

Install the typed SDK and skip the cryptography. Three integration paths: read-only (no wallet), standard EOA, or a passkey account with optional gas sponsorship.

npm i @designerhub/sdk viem
import { publicClient, readTotalSupply, readScheme, readSplitPreview } from "@designerhub/sdk";

const client = publicClient();                       // Monad Testnet (10143)
const s = await readScheme(client, await readTotalSupply(client));
console.log(s.creator, s.parentId, s.remixCount, s.priceWei);
import { createPasskey, rpIdHashHex, originHashHex, passkeyFactoryAbi,
         buildAttestData, deriveSingleChallenge, signAssertion,
         publicClient, monadTestnet } from "@designerhub/sdk";

const cred = await createPasskey({ rpId: "yourdomain.xyz" });
const account = await publicClient().readContract({
  address: monadTestnet.passkeyAccountFactory, abi: passkeyFactoryAbi,
  functionName: "accountOf",
  args: [BigInt(cred.x), BigInt(cred.y),
         rpIdHashHex("yourdomain.xyz"), originHashHex("https://yourdomain.xyz")],
});
// → submit P256PasskeyAccount.execute(to, 0, data, assertion) from ANY relayer

Originality & Track Insight (15%)

Why it isn’t capturable by a single platform

  • No platform vault. Payments go straight from buyer to creator/platform/ancestor in the same transaction — there is nothing to freeze and no operator-held balance.
  • Lineage is on-chain, not in a database. Attribution survives any single app.
  • The relayer is permissionless and replaceable. execute(...) can be called by anyone — the signature, not the sender, is the authorization.
  • Identity is the user’s. A passkey in the user’s secure element, not a custodial account.
  • Privacy-preserving. Content itself never touches the chain — only a commitment hash.

Founder & Market Readiness (25%)

Who builds on this — and why not roll your own

AdopterWhy they’d choose it over rolling their own
Generative / design tools
(e.g., the VirtuHome app itself)		On-chain attribution and revenue split without writing WebAuthn/P256 verification, CREATE2 accounts, or lineage math.
Content marketplaces / asset libraries
(3D assets, floor plans, presets)		Drop-in passkey login (no seed phrases, higher conversion) plus enforceable resale royalty and remix lineage.
AI-agent platforms / model & data providersA neutral, on-chain record of which model produced what — for audit, disputes, and agent reputation.
Identity / wallet SDKsA reference P-256 WebAuthn account with a pure-Solidity verifier that works on chains without the RIP-7212 precompile (Monad included).

Rolling your own means re-implementing: WebAuthn assertion parsing and P-256 verification (EC2 COSE keys, DER→(r, s), low-s edge cases), a CREATE2 account with replay-safe nonces, an anti-tamper challenge scheme, an attestation registry, and a lineage-aware revenue splitter — about a week of security-sensitive work, compressed into a few typed calls.

Traction & Path Forward (20%)

Honest status and a concrete plan

Early but moving. Traction today is a first-party integrator (the VirtuHome app, which already exports the scheme JSON), plus active partnership talks with an operating interior-design firm to help their designers produce AI-generated schemes and anchor authorship on-chain. We state this plainly rather than overclaim.
  • Ship the kit (done): publish @designerhub/sdk plus an integration guide and runnable examples.
  • Partner with a real design firm (in progress): work with an operating interior-design company so their designers use the app to generate schemes with AI and anchor each plan’s ownership on-chain — a live, non-self-served use case.
  • Post-event: run a marketing campaign on Xiaohongshu (RED) to grow site exposure and user engagement, open a small integration-bounty / “built on Designer Hub” track, add a builtWith registry, and host the app (a demo URL and recorded video).
  • Follow-ups: keep refining schemes based on user feedback, add more showcase features, meter and scale the relayer, add per-agent analytics on AgentRegistry, and draft an EIP for the commitment-and-lineage pattern.

Support needed

What would help us go further

  • Compute / token support — GPU and model-token credits to keep generating schemes and meter the relayer at scale.
  • Partner with Kimi — an official collaboration with Kimi (already on-chain as agentId = 1) to co-market the integration and grow exposure.
